common_interface.mask_rule: one public boolean mask per tensor; true exactly where a native finite value was copied
common_interface.pad_rule: cast native finite numeric matrix to float32, copy in row-major order to the upper-left corner, fill every remaining cell with positive zero
forbidden_adapter_behavior: family labels, native class names or paths
semantic channel names or manual control/state/regime alignment
family-specific scaling, projection, permutation, truncation or hyperparameters
target or test-result access while constructing public inputs

ncmapss_ds08a_portable_v1.support_input: row-wise concatenation of native public W and X_s
ncmapss_ds08a_portable_v1.support_target: next native public X_s row within the same unit and cycle
ncmapss_ds08a_portable_v1.history: last 32 concatenated W and X_s rows

heldout_dronepropa_factor_recombination_.support_input: row-wise concatenation of the already frozen native public motor controls and states
heldout_dronepropa_factor_recombination_.support_target: next native public state row within the same whole flight
heldout_dronepropa_factor_recombination_.history: last 32 concatenated control and state rows

continuous_event_predictive_state_v1.support_input: the native 108-row public episode channel matrix
continuous_event_predictive_state_v1.support_target: the native 108-row scalar target as one column
continuous_event_predictive_state_v1.history: the final 32 rows of the public support episode
continuous_event_predictive_state_v1.future_public: the native ForecastQuery channel matrix, using a frozen 50-step query
continuous_event_predictive_state_v1.output: the native 50-step scalar forecast as one column

normalization.rule: per tensor column mean and standard deviation from public training worlds only; masked cells are excluded

loss.primary: mean squared normalized error over true output-mask cells, averaged within world then equally across families

causal_candidates.shared: one source-identical learner and hyperparameter set slow-fitted on pooled training worlds
causal_candidates.independent: source-identical clones slow-fitted separately per evaluator-private family group; all clone fit/state/costs are summed
causal_candidates.no_cross_family: for each evaluated family, the same learner receives no slow-fit worlds from that family and adapts on the identical public support as shared
causal_candidates.support_only: same learner with no slow-fit worlds, adapted on identical public support

transfer_success_requires: shared beats independent on overall and minimum-family capability
no-cross-family beats support-only in every family
shared is not Pareto-dominated by independent, pooled probabilistic or native specialist controls
family router accuracy is reported but never itself counted as transfer
all acquisition, serialization, normalization, slow fit, support adaptation, query, update, bytes, state and R1/R4/R16 costs are charged

shape_gate.fixed_development_source: DS08a unit 1, first DronePropA training flight, continuous-event seed 1103 width 32
requirements: all five tensors and masks have frozen shapes
all copied values are finite and exactly recoverable after float32 cast
DS08a windows do not cross unit or cycle
DronePropA windows do not cross whole flight
all four causal candidate data assignments are constructible without changing learner source
